newsitem.title: MOROCCO: DAEWOO BUYS MOROCCO HYATT REGENCY HOTEL FOR $28.7 MLN.
newsitem.headline: DAEWOO BUYS MOROCCO HYATT REGENCY HOTEL FOR $28.7 MLN.

text.p: South Korean giant Daewoo corporation has bought Morocco's five-star Hyatt Regency hotel for $28.7 million, a Moroccan senior official said on Friday.
"The $28.7 million agreement was signed between Daewoo Corporation and the state-owned Caisse de Depot et Gestion bank late on Thursday night," the official said.
The South Korean firm will invest an extra $10 million to renovate and extend the hotel, he added.
Built on eight-hectare (20 acre) site, the Hyatt Regency is located in a residential area, close to Rabat Royal palace.

Daewoo was continuing talks with the Moroccan authorities to implement a $500 million investment projects deal in the North African country on telecommunications, tourism, electronics and the car industry, officials said.
Daewoo signed an agreement of principle on the $500 million investment with the government last July in Rabat.
"The move aimed at attracting a professional international investor and develop high standards of tourism accommodation from which the country will benefit in the long term," the official said.
The Hyatt Regency has 220 rooms, 28 suites and employs a staff of more 300. ($1= 8.8 dirhams) -- Ali Bouzerda, Rabat newsroom +2127 726518
